intentAndPurpose.intent: Circular progress arc. Determinate variant renders an arc proportional to `value`; indeterminate renders a spinning animation. Optional center content (icon or auto percentage). 10 t-shirt sizes. Multi-accent appearance roles.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable entry + exit animations. Default: false (opt-in). Pair with `show` for controlled visibility.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Multi-accent appearance role. Auto/unset inherits Surface, then falls back to secondary.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: ID of element that labels this progress indicator

props.name: children
props.description: Children rendered as icon when content='icon'

props.name: content
props.description: Center content: 'none'=empty, 'icon'=render children as icon, 'text'=auto percentage label. Default: 'none'.

props.name: data-testid
props.description: Optional test hook — forwarded to the root visual container (the ring wrapper).

props.name: material
props.description: Metallic material for the active arc. `'none'` (default) uses the role colour; any metal swaps the arc stroke for the brand metallic gradient.

props.name: show
props.description: Controlled visibility. When `animate` is true, toggling `show` triggers entry or exit. Default: true.

props.name: size
props.description: Size preset — maps to spacing dimension tokens. Default: 'M'.

props.name: variant
props.description: Determinate shows arc proportional to value; indeterminate shows spinning animation. Default: 'determinate'.

interactionBehavior.summary: CircularProgressIndicator is not a control: no hover, press, or focus styles, and no `tabindex`, so it is skipped in the tab order. Base UI Progress exposes `role="progressbar"`. Determinate (a finite `value`) sets `aria-valuenow` plus `aria-valuemin` / `aria-valuemax` (default 0–100). Indeterminate — `variant="indeterminate"` OR a missing `value`, even if variant is still `determinate` — omits `aria-valuenow` and uses Base UI's `aria-valuetext="indeterminate progress"`; `aria-busy` is not set. The SVG is `aria-hidden`; centre percentage / icon sit in `pointer-events: none` layers so they never steal a tap from a parent. `show={false}` (and the post-100 determinate exit when `animate` is on) unmounts the progressbar entirely, so assistive tech no longer sees it. Pass `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` — there is no default name. A determinate value change animates smoothly: the arc's `stroke-dashoffset` transitions over `--CircularProgressIndicator-valueTransitionDuration` (default `--Motion-Duration-3XL`) with `--CircularProgressIndicator-valueTransitionEasing` (`--Motion-Easing-Transition-Moderate`) so the ring sweeps to the new value rather than snapping — override the duration to `0s` for instant continuous tracking. Indeterminate sets `transition: none` on that same property, and reduced-motion collapses it to instant. Indeterminate motion composes `cpi-indeterminate-rotate` with `cpi-indeterminate-head` / `-tail`, and `animate` adds paired enter/exit keyframes for the root, track, indicator, label and icon. Its reduced-motion fallback is the most considered in the progress family: rather than just stopping, the indeterminate arc collapses to a deliberate static ~25% arc (`--cpi-indeterminate-head: 25`) that still reads as 'in progress'.
